unlisted_practices: Using FHIR as a standard data layer to deploy machine learning models across heterogeneous health information systems
Integrating predictive model alerts via CDS Hooks and SMART on FHIR apps

screen.reason: Describes and demonstrates a technical integration framework (MoCab) using SMART on FHIR and CDS Hooks for deploying machine learning models, tested on synthetic EHR data, but does not evaluate a specific governance or deployment guardrail/practice intervention comparatively.
